parts.name: Flipping Lid
parts.Basic_description: The flipping lid is the front cover of the phone, likely made of glass, serving as the display surface.
parts.Functional_description: It protects the screen and allows user interaction through touch or display visibility.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or flip open and closed around a hinge connecting it to the base body.

parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: A small plastic button located on the phone surface, used for power or function control.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to turn the device on/off or perform specific actions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves slightly inward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: A small metallic component possibly used for hinge or structural reinforcement.
parts.Functional_description: It provides mechanical support or acts as a connector between the lid and base body.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed but allows rotational movement of the flipping lid around it.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the phone, made of aluminum alloy, housing internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports and protects internal electronics, battery, and circuit boards.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the structural foundation for the entire device.
